commands.label: Select the actual emulator objects without interactive debugger bookkeeping
Compile a console-only harness against the unchanged real Block II emulator
Execute the real machine instructions and inspect the native accumulator readback

agc_engine.h: void ChannelOutput (agc_t * State, int Channel, int Value);

toolchain: VirtualAGC yaYUL and libyaAGC native emulator
reproduction_command: yaYUL hello.agc; link native emulator check.c; ./check hello.agc.bin
semantic_scope: The official assembler and native Block II emulation core processed the unchanged code. Reading its A register confirmed the intended octal greeting byte after executing the original instructions.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
